record: Per-role model split experiment — DevOps as a Service, Oct 25, 2026 (maximizer iteration 11)
method: Same as eval-scorecard/live-runs.json: pipeline.run per seeded issue against a fresh git-initialized copy of hackathon-demo-repo, ConnectorClient (Meta Model API via custom.meta-model-api connector, no env key). Split applied through ConnectorClient role_models (the DAAS_MODEL_<ROLE> mechanism). muse-wonder-1.0 availability probed live through the connector before the runs (tiny JSON completion, ok).
decision_rule_registered_before_runs: 1) pass count (work tiers + guardrail correct); 2) total discovered-test growth across work tiers; 3) total wall clock (lower wins). Split kept only if it wins on (1), or ties (1) and wins on (2), or ties (1)-(2) and wins on (3); a full tie keeps uniform (also cheaper per token).

runs.reviewer_notes: Checked diff: single off-by-one fix in app/pagination.py (end-1 to end) with no unrelated changes; tests_ok=true and count rose 6 to 9 matching 3 new tests in tests/test_pagination_regression.py, which cover first/full pages regression and partial last page.
